Explicit 3-state classification enforced: (1) unmeasured = feature absent from dataset feature_dataset_presence_matrix (e.g. CD28 in macaque fetal lung dataset 2e877cd3-5587-4fc1-8667-a48fe9e2a695); (2) undetected = 0 captured UMI counts (X['raw'] == 0) in a dataset where feature_dataset_presence_matrix == 1 (2853 / 4282 human blood CD4+ TEM cells reflecting 3' droplet scRNA-seq capture dropout / low transcript copy number); (3) biologically absent = true absence of functional gene/protein expression in the population, which cannot be inferred from sparse scRNA-seq zero counts or from missing atlas cell types/tissues

inconclusive: Homo sapiens blood CD4+ effector-memory T cells (CL:0000905) in dataset ed5d841d-6346-47d4-ab2f-7119ad7e3a35 show CD28 (ENSG00000178562) detection fraction 0.3337 (1429 / 4282 cells across 8 donors), whereas macaca_mulatta has 0 comparable CD4+ effector-memory T-cell (CL:0000905 / CL:0001087) or blood/lymphoid datasets in CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08; no cross-species biological equivalence or divergence can be claimed from this source

CELLxGENE Census dataset 'Inflammatory blockade in premature Rhesus macaques exposed to intra-uterine inflammation' (Inflammatory blockade prevents injury to the developing pulmonary gas exchange surface in preterm primates) DOI: 10.1126/scitranslmed.abl8574
CELLxGENE Census dataset 'Single-nucleus transcriptome data from the dlPFC: Rhesus' (Molecular and cellular evolution of the primate dorsolateral prefrontal cortex) DOI: 10.1126/science.abo7257

limitations: Missing comparable animal population in CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08: macaca_mulatta contains 0 blood or lymphoid-tissue datasets and 0 cells annotated as CD4+ effector-memory T cells (CL:0000905 / CL:0001087) or CD4+ T cells (CL:0000624), rendering the cross-species comparison inconclusive.

Explicit distinction between unmeasured, undetected, and biologically absent: features absent from a dataset's feature_dataset_presence_matrix are unmeasured (e.g. CD28 in macaque dataset 2e877cd3-5587-4fc1-8667-a48fe9e2a695); zero UMI counts (X['raw'] == 0) in a measured dataset are undetected due to sparse 3' droplet capture efficiency (~5-15% mRNA capture); neither establishes that the protein is biologically absent.

RNA transcript detection versus cell-surface protein abundance: CELLxGENE Census stores single-cell/single-nucleus RNA UMI counts (X['raw']) and does not expose paired CITE-seq ADT surface-protein abundance or post-translational surface density, which govern functional receptor engagement (such as CD28 superagonist binding in CD4+ effector-memory T cells).

Cell-type annotation and suspension-type non-equivalence: generic 'T cell' (CL:0000084) annotations in non-lymphoid parenchyma or single-nucleus RNA-seq (fc6ef080-9e5f-4aea-b9c4-a45a208bd288) pool CD4+, CD8+, gamma-delta, and regulatory T cells and sample only nuclear pre-mRNA/mRNA, making them biologically and technically incomparable to whole-cell peripheral blood CD4+ effector-memory T cells.

Cross-dataset normalisation and batch effects: CELLxGENE Census release 2025-11-08 provides raw UMI counts (X['raw']) without a cross-species batch-corrected expression layer; direct numerical comparison across independent studies, chemistries, and reference genome builds (GRCh38 vs Mmul_10) is confounded without matched experimental design.
